organ: the arena: two owned cards fight on one batch both owners’ signatures chose, the better ranking wins, and every duel re-runs
population: every set with two or more departments in the drop: 40 seeded pairs of its genesis cards, each card handed to its own demo owner, each pair fighting five duels (1,000 duels); twelve kinds of forgery on the first 20 pairs (240); the ratings of all the duels

rules.claim: Every one of the 1,000 duels re-runs, from its receipt, its two cards, the ground and the two signed records, to the very same receipt.
Every duel’s batch is 64 distinct GATE rows of its ground, and no duel reads a TEST row.

All 240 forgeries are refused: an edited challenge, a challenge or acceptance signed by a stranger, an acceptance for another challenge, a stale challenge or acceptance after a give, an edited score, winner or self-play flag in a receipt, a ground of another business, a card fighting itself, an acceptance with an extra field.
The ratings of all the duels, computed twice in their order, are identical, and their total is exactly 1,000 points times the number of rated cards.
In at least 60% of the pairs a majority of five duels decides, the winner is the card with the higher TEST AUC.
At least 10% of the decided duels are won by the card with the lower GATE AUC: a duel is a fight, not a lookup of the two scores.
The median duel takes at most 250 milliseconds on the measuring machine, signatures included.
